SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION RECORD FD-02. Fictional organisations, people, dates and facts. Not a real record.
Supplier-access exception, completed draft. Reference SYN-FD-02.
On 10 March 2031 Brisenfold Logistics Ltd requested access to the dock-scheduling system of Halvenmoor Instruments for six weeks. The supplier-access policy requires a signed data-handling agreement before access is granted, and no signed agreement was on file on 10 March 2031. On 11 March 2031 the procurement lead, Doran Velquist, approved an exception to the agreement requirement. The approval note reads: "Exception approved; the supplier is low risk." Access was granted on 12 March 2031 and ends on 21 April 2031.

basis_identification.note: The record states a low-risk conclusion and does not name what that conclusion rests on.

findings.note: Low risk is asserted, and nothing in the record shows the basis for it.
